enabled.description: Whether to enable and start the hd-idle service.

listen_interface.description: Optional interface name (e.g., 'usb') to listen for device events; leave empty to disable event-based spindown.

devices.description: List of disks to manage with hd-idle. Each entry defines a disk and its idle timeout.

idle_time_sec.description: Idle time in seconds after which the disk should spin down. Use 0 to disable spindown for this disk.

log_file.description: Optional path to a log file where hd-idle writes events (e.g., '/var/log/hd-idle.log').
